name: Coin Tour
summary: A four-step wallet welcome screen where one 3D gold coin travels, flips and follows your swipe
about: A phone onboarding flow for a wallet app, built around a single thick 3D coin that never leaves the screen. On each step the coin glides to a new spot, flips to a new angle and is joined by its own scene: orbiting coins, a payment flying to a friend, a spinning shield, a chart that draws itself. Swiping drags the text and turns the coin with your finger, and the last step's button grows into Create wallet with a working and a done state. Good for a wallet, banking or finance app.
how: Press the round Next button, tap a dot, use Skip, or swipe the screen left and right (arrow keys work when it has focus).
While you drag, the text slides and the coin turns with your finger; let go and it springs to the next step or back.
Each step moves and flips the coin and brings in its own little scene and floating info chips, with the text lines rising one by one.
On the last step the button stretches into Create wallet: press it to watch the coin whirl, then sparkle when the wallet is ready.
